hook: DeepMind asks: what comes after AGI?

beats.say: A DeepMind essay argues that with AGI within reach, AI could keep advancing toward artificial superintelligence, or ASI.
Training compute needed for a fixed performance level has fallen roughly three to six times per year. Combined, effective compute grows at least ten times a year.
At that rate, work costing a billion dollars in compute today would cost just a thousand dollars in ten years.
